notes: Se conservan los prompts completos utilizados para producir estas ocho insignias, incluida la edición de la boquita de Rocky.
Las rutas de referencia están normalizadas al contenido del ZIP; se pasaron como referenced_image_paths.
Los siete prompts iniciales especifican una retícula lógica aproximada de 64 × 64; Rocky iguala su estilo y densidad de píxeles. Los ocho PNG exportados tienen 1254 × 1254 píxeles.
Los títulos incluidos en los prompts son guía conceptual; no se dibujan sobre las insignias.
No se registró una semilla ni un modelo específico en la llamada. Una nueva generación puede variar.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE standalone transparent pixel-art achievement badge for a cozy educational exploration video game called Bitácora Amorcito. Primary request: create one NEW badge in the same coherent set as the attached active-listening badge. Input image 1 is ONLY a STYLE and MEDAL TEMPLATE reference, not the new subject. Use the same frontal round medallion silhouette, chunky stepped circular embossed rim, upper-left pale pixel highlights, lower-right darker pixel shading, little squared corners and pixelated edge. Match the reference's small, limited-palette retro-game pixel language. Keep the symmetrical small leafy branches curving up around the lower left and lower right of the central symbol, recolored to harmonize with this badge. Replace the ear entirely with the subject specified below. Make the central symbol large and readable at game UI sizes. Low-resolution pixel art drawn on a consistent coarse approximately 64 by 64 pixel logical grid, enlarged cleanly with nearest-neighbor-looking solid square pixel clusters. Flat color clusters, crisp square corners, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients, no noise texture, no vector-style soft edges, no photorealism, no 3D render. Square canvas. Center exactly one medal taking up about 86 percent of the canvas width with an even transparent margin, all elements fully inside the round silhouette. True transparent alpha background OUTSIDE the medal; the inner disc stays opaque. No text, no lettering, no numerals, no labels, no watermark, no extra icons outside the medal, no contact sheet. Treat the learning title and meaning only as conceptual guidance, never print words.
Learning and reflective meaning: Plantas y semillas · Curiosidad que florece
New central subject: Two small golden sunflowers with brown seed centers and green stems, one taller than the other, inspired closely by image 2. Simplify the sunflower bouquet to two flowers and just a few leaves, no extra orange flower. They symbolize noticing where plants begin, valuing germination, and curiosity about nature.
Palette: green embossed rim as in the original reference, deep forest-green inner disc, golden sunflower petals, warm brown seeds, fresh green leaves

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a transparent pixel-art collectible badge PNG.
Input image 1 is the Rocky badge to edit. Input image 2 is Jerry's badge, supplied ONLY as the reference for the shape and expression of the open mouth.
Primary request: Edit only Rocky's little mouth in image 1 so it is open and cute exactly like Jerry's mouth in image 2: a small happy dark open mouth with a tiny rounded pink tongue sticking out, rendered as crisp chunky square pixel clusters. Match the gentle, adorable expression and approximate relative mouth size from Jerry, while adapting it naturally to Rocky's existing brown muzzle.
Constraints and invariants: Keep Rocky's brown fur, eyes, dark nose, ears, halo, blue shirt with white square patches, red heart, gold medallion, laurels, framing, pixel density, image dimensions and all remaining pixels as unchanged as possible. No new collar. Keep true transparency outside the badge and opaque brown inside. Do not make the muzzle white, do not change eyes or nose, do not enlarge the whole face, do not add a grin or teeth. No text, no labels, no watermark. Exactly one complete badge on the same square canvas. Change only the small area of the mouth below the nose.

Image 3 is supporting reference of the same Rocky character in pixel-art poses.
Primary request: Create the matching ROCKY badge by replacing Jerry inside the medallion of Image 1 with Rocky from Images 2 and 3. Keep the same stepped circular gold medal silhouette, gold highlights, dark brown recessed center, dark pixel outlines, paired gold laurel branches at the lower sides and the small red heart on the right. Match the Jerry badge closely in scale and composition.
Subject: A charming front-facing head-and-chest portrait of Rocky, with short warm caramel / cinnamon brown fur, large upright triangular ears with pale pink inner ear pixels, a slightly longer and narrower muzzle than Jerry, large dark expressive eyes with tiny square white highlights, dark nose, and a friendly small smile. Show the blue shirt with distinct white square patches around his chest, as in the character references. Include his small gold pixel halo floating above his head, fully inside the medallion with a visible dark gap above the ears. Retain Rocky's distinctive appearance; do not make his face white.

Use the reference badge's pixel density, no painterly or smooth vector rendering, no excessive realistic detail.

Maintain approximately the same outer badge diameter, border thickness and transparent margin as Image 1. All ear tips, halo, face and shirt must fit within the gold medallion. Laurel branches may overlap the lower shirt as in Image 1. Full badge visible, no cut-off edges.
Scene/backdrop: Genuine transparent alpha outside the medallion only, keep the dark brown medal interior opaque. No black backdrop and no checkerboard painted into the image.
Text: none.
Constraints: Keep the original badge frame and laurel design as unchanged as possible. Change the central dog identity and clothing only, and add the halo indicated by the Rocky references. No red collar from Jerry. No extra dogs, no wings, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no labels, no multiple variants or sheet.
